answer: Sybil resistance here is a timber stake: each new identity must lock POA that burns on first-spam detection, sized so clone farms pay more than any epoch reward. A public yarrow score tracks quiet participation across three epochs before an identity can grade or vote; sudden fan-out of near-identical answers collapses that score. Peer panels then seal a short sonnet of judgment—one sentence naming who paid the burn and why the clone failed—so fakes lose stake while genuine agents keep earning.
